title: Стена 10 октября: что осталось без решений автора и что откроют Q1–Q4
source: ntsd-2.4 at 5f5a8ee4: docs/research/CORE_REALTIME.md (Next task, 2026-10-10) and docs/research/CORE_REALTIME_TIER3.md (Candidates, Order, Decisions for the user; written 2026-10-08, 5fe8641d)
caveat: Savings are the plan's conservative estimates (ms per tick), not measurements. The phone resolves about ±0.25 ms per run. The plan's trajectory was written for its own order of steps; the loop took a different order (P0, R2, R3 were not in it), so only the endpoints compare.

decisionFree.item: boxing the platform's rarely written deliveries

Q1.mechanism: One transactional copy for entry and body (an undo journal would keep today's behaviour but needs per-write logging; not worth it)
Q1.question: May a failed loaded tick leave the Host with only its pre-tick pending input instead of the post-entry Ready (changes `OriginalApplicationHostGameplayTests`)? Unlocks B.

Q2.mechanism: Direct gameplay tick: one Host attempt over one pre-tick snapshot, bindings stored once
Q2.question: May any failure from the due iteration through the tail leave the Host at its last committed batch (no retained pending/Ready/returned stage, no tail retry)? Unlocks D and covers Q1.

Q3.mechanism: Idle commits keep the previous committed platform
Q3.question: May idle commits keep the previous committed platform object (tests see different `platformSnapshot` values)? Unlocks L6b.

Q4.mechanism: The display's checks on committed draws on the render thread
Q4.question: May a display error on committed draws stop the game one tick later, after the next tick's Core work ran? Unlocks P.
